title: CoinDCX confirms $16 million loss from retired wallets days after CEO called breach reports a ‘false alarm’
reason: Confirmed $16 million exchange breach with a named company and a direct reversal of the CEO's public 'false alarm' claim is clearly publishable security news.

sources.summary: CEO Sumit Gupta had told X users on Wednesday that early reports of a breach sounded like "a false alarm."
